title: A personal challenge with clear rules
description: A program for a chosen term with daily actions and a history of attempts. Before the start you can see how a day is counted and what happens after a miss.

blocks.text: Someone taking on a personal challenge wants to see which items are left for today. In one review the app declared the day failed before the author had managed to enter the last actions. The rule for ending the day turned out to matter more than any extra rewards.

quote.text: I was very much enjoying the app until I went to add my last two tasks tonight and my app expressed that I had failed. Like many others have expressed this is the very opposite of motivating.

blocks.text: Let a person set the rules of their own challenge, its length and the day boundary. Explain why a day counts as completed or missed. Allow a mistaken entry to be corrected while keeping the history of attempts and the conditions that were chosen.

Test the evening of the last action, a late check-in and the start of a new attempt. Does the result match the rules the person accepted at the beginning? A catalog of other people’s programs isn’t needed while your own conditions can’t be carried out and checked without confusion.
